obligation.title: Mandatory VAT registration (draft reading of Decree-Law Art. 13 and 19, Executive Regulation Art. 7)

support_quotes.quote: Every Person, who has a Place of Residence in the State or an Implementing State, shall register for Tax in the following situations
Where the total value of all supplies referred to in Article 19 of this Decree-Law exceeded the Mandatory Registration Threshold over the previous 12 -month period
will exceed the Mandatory Registration Threshold in the next 30 days
1. The value of taxable Goods and Services.
2. The value of Concerned Goods and Concerned Services received by the Person
The Mandatory Registration Threshold shall be AED 375,000
must file a Tax Registration application with the Authority within 30 (thirty) days of being required to register
